subject.title: refactor(plugin-sdk): narrow wildcard barrels to explicit used exports

question: Should unobserved symbols from shipped non-deprecated plugin SDK entrypoints be removed immediately, or must they follow the documented compatibility window?
rationale: Consumer-corpus evidence cannot prove that every external plugin was observed, while current repository policy treats shipped public plugin APIs as compatibility contracts.

options.title: Follow compatibility policy
options.body: Restore omitted exports and retire them through explicit deprecation records and a major-version or completed removal window.

options.title: Approve immediate contraction
options.body: Treat observed-corpus usage as the support boundary and accept that unobserved external plugins may stop compiling after the next minor release.

recommendation.title: Follow compatibility policy
recommendation.body: Restore omitted exports and retire them through explicit deprecation records and a major-version or completed removal window.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns both the preceding contract-window phase and the current narrowing phase, making them the clearest available owner for confirming the intended SDK policy.
